verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API covers a solid set of objects (recordings, action items, notes read/write, webhooks, uploads, authenticated user) matching much of the meeting-notes UI, and MCP tooling extends this to AI assistants. However there is no evidence that admin-console features like org-wide retention/recording policies, keyword tracking, transcript redaction settings, or meeting scheduling/calendar management are exposed via the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s), so full UI-API parity is not demonstrated. missing for 10: API coverage for admin/org policy settings (retention, recording policies), keyword tracking/redaction configuration via API, meeting scheduling endpoints, and a comprehensive spec/independent confirmation of full parity.
